operative_text:
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.21(C)(2)): Divisions (B)(2) and (3) of this section do not apply to the sale and furnishing of a handgun to a person eighteen years of age or older and under twenty-one years of age if the person selling or furnishing the handgun to the person eighteen years of age or older and under twenty-one years of age is a federally licensed firearms dealer.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.211(C)(2)): The person purchases or attempts to purchase a handgun from a federally licensed firearms dealer.
Section 1 (R.C. 2923.211(C)): No person under twenty-one years of age shall purchase or attempt to purchase a handgun, provided that this division does not apply to the purchase or attempted purchase of a handgun by a person eighteen years of age or older and under twenty-one years of age if any of the following apply:
